camp.about: The crew stocks its first expedition supplies here.

well.about: Water buckets earn 3 Food each from expedition 5.

workshop.about: Cut blocks earn 5 Supplies each from expedition 8.

market.about: Adds ration jars to later expeditions.

gateway.about: Helmets replace sun coins, 6 Coins each.

lodge.about: Adds grain bundles worth 5 Food each.

archive.about: Adds carved quartz worth 7 Supplies each.

observatory.about: From the lookout, a lamp can guide boats away from the damaged quay.

log_cabin.about: Hammer gems join later expeditions. Match them to charge a hit on one cell.

map_room.about: Tide Chart gems join later expeditions. Match them to half-charge your other bonuses.

water_mill.about: Shutter Gear gems join later expeditions. Match them to charge a shuffle.

clock_tower.about: Amphora gems join later expeditions. Match them to charge 5 more moves.

lighthouse.about: Lightning gems join later expeditions. Match them to charge a strike on 20 cells.

amphitheater.about: Shield gems join later expeditions. Match them to charge a row strike.
